undescended.definition: a. (of the testis) remaining in the abdomen instead of descending into the scrotum
undescended.translation: a. 未降到阴囊的（睾丸）

undescribable.translation: a. 难以笔墨形容的, 难以叙述的

undescribed.translation: a. 未描写的,未描述的

undeserved.translation: a. (赏、罚等)不该受的, 不应得的

undeservedly.translation: adv. 不应得地, 不当地

undeserver.definition: n. One of no merit; one who is nor deserving or worthy.
undeserver.translation: n. 不该受赏的人, 不足道的人

undeserving.translation: a. 不配受到的, 不值得...的

undesigned.definition: a. not done or made or performed with purpose or intent
undesigned.translation: a. 非故意的, 非预谋的, 无意中的

undesignedly.translation: adv. 非故意地, 无意中, 无心地

undesigning.definition:
a. Having no artful, ulterior, or fraudulent purpose;
   sincere; artless; simple.

undesirability.definition: n. the quality possessed by something that should be avoided
undesirability.translation: 不受欢迎, 不良, 不愉快, 不合需要

undesirable.definition:
n. one whose presence is undesirable
a. not wanted
s. not worthy of being chosen (especially as a spouse)
undesirable.translation:
a. 不受欢迎的, 不合乎社会道德标准的
[法] 不受欢迎的人, 不良份子, 不法份子

undesirables.definition: n. one whose presence is undesirable
undesirables.translation: n. 不受欢迎的人, 不良分子( undesirable的复数形式 )

undesirably.translation: adv. 令人不快地；不受欢迎地

undesired.translation:
a. 不希望得到的, 非所要求的
[计] 不需要的

undesired signal.translation: [计] 干扰信号, 不需要的信号

undesirous.definition: a having or feeling no desire
undesirous.translation: a. 不存想望的,无欲望的(of)
